confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one web search of cost-of-living aggregators (MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables). Those pages show beer at about $2.4-2.9, cappuccino at about $2.6-3.3 and an inexpensive meal at about $10-12, with figures varying by page. I found no cocktail or wine-by-the-glass prices, so I set those from typical central European relationships to beer. The mid-range meal for two is a bounded estimate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings, and July is peak season. For the FX observation I ran one search, which returned the RBA page showing 0.6720 USD per AUD at 4pm on 18 November 2026 as the latest figure. The search did not return the underlying table, so I did not open the page myself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Vienna's neighbours Prague, Budapest and Ljubljana: cheaper than Vienna, with eurozone pricing and strong tourism demand.
